scope: Upstream server/provider/orchestration family inventory for full Rust destination; no product changes or execution

user_outcomes: Run local/headless server; connect independent web/desktop/mobile/CLI clients; keep environment identity stable
families.rust_owner: EnvironmentSupervisor plus RuntimeConfig and process owner
invariants: Environment ID and recovery publication atomic
Routes alter reachability, never execution owner
Connection presence does not establish projection freshness
Independent client/server compatibility and feature negotiation

user_outcomes: Pair clients; revoke access; OAuth/DPoP; scoped sessions; answer secret requests
families.rust_owner: AuthorizationService with durable credential/session state and revocation fanout
invariants: One-time consumption and conditional redemption
Empty permissions authoritative; grants narrow only
Invalid DPoP never falls back to bearer
Permission/runtime ceilings checked at operation and under thread lock
Signed asset URLs bind canonical file identity
Live session revocation closes or safely rebinds authorized sockets

user_outcomes: Create/manage threads; send, queue, steer, stop or retry work; fork, merge and switch provider
families.rust_owner: Typed Orchestrator with keyed thread actors and deletion coordination
invariants: Atomic command receipt, events, authoritative projections and outbox
Duplicate receipt never repeats side effects
Intent acknowledgement distinct from external completion
Global deletion lock before thread locks
Provider output enters same ordered state machine
Unknown external outcome cannot be retried on another adapter silently

user_outcomes: Read shell, long history, search, live output, diffs, item details and family views
families.rust_owner: Projection/query owner plus bounded subscription service
invariants: Replay sequence and snapshot fences coherent
Streaming ACK budget includes in-flight bytes
Coalescing respects barriers and terminal ordering
Inherited/folded/cancelled/runless history semantics preserved
Shell omissions do not mean deleted
Wire defaults/null/absence/version negotiation preserved
cost_opportunities: Materialize exact command facts and history rank blocks to avoid residual full-index paths; prior DB report
Encode bounded event once per negotiated wire shape and share immutable bytes
Owner-local chunked text accumulation with measured materialization points

user_outcomes: Use installed Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok, fx, OpenCode, Antigravity, Kiro, Pi, Muse and ACP Registry agents
families.rust_owner: ProviderRegistry plus per-instance adapter/session actors
invariants: Per-instance mutable state/accounts/catalogs
Capabilities report real protocol support; handshake may narrow
No side-effectful login/session start during background health checks
Own only installed binaries updater can prove it owns
Stop waits for native start boundary and owned process shutdown
Background native work can outlive parent run and wake it later
Provider option IDs preserved
cost_opportunities: Reduce T3 adapter/intermediate object work, not external model latency
Cursor native protocol/storage parity remains blocker; shared worker already optimized

user_outcomes: Approve/decline native tools; answer blocking and asynchronous questions; resolve elicitation
families.rust_owner: RuntimeRequestService integrated with thread transaction and provider callback registry
invariants: Provider native policy cannot be replaced by weaker T3 prompt rules
Asynchronous Codex questions survive turn/process end
Live callback and persisted message-answer workflows differ
Late answers, cancellation and refusal distinctions preserved
Read-only and plan limits cannot be escalated through remote tools

user_outcomes: Review changes, revert a checkpoint, fork history, merge results or hand context to another provider
families.rust_owner: CheckpointCoordinator plus native provider rollback and context handoff services
invariants: Provider rollback feasibility checked before file mutation
Multi-repository restore and cancellation preserve atomic plan boundaries
Fork ancestor timestamp/cutoff/rollback semantics
Portable handoff conveys text evidence, not native hidden state
Task-folder non-repository links remain shared, not copied
Watcher hints alone cannot prove clean state
cost_opportunities: Reliable dirty-generation journal may skip redundant repository scans only with fence, watch-loss detection and reconciliation
Use stable repository snapshots for repeated diff views; Git semantics remain authority

user_outcomes: Delegate child work, inspect native children/scripts, stop workflows, wake parent after local/remote completion
families.rust_owner: DelegationCoordinator and WorkflowService
invariants: Native child identity independent of currently active parent run
Background tool/task updates after turn end retained
Remote child ordinary thread on remote owner with durable follower recovery
Completion deliveries acknowledged/disposed idempotently
Unavailable native operations represented honestly

user_outcomes: Launch work from repository/PR/issue/task; observe progress; cancel, fail and retry preparation
families.rust_owner: ThreadLaunchService plus worktree/setup process supervisor
invariants: Fetch/checkout/submodules/setup/agent stages have explicit progress and ownership
Preparation failure distinct from provider failure
Cancellation removes only owned artifacts
Linked limited-access work skips setup scripts
Prepared run release/queue admission is durable

user_outcomes: Create/import/clone/manage projects; scratch threads; multi-repository task folders
families.rust_owner: ProjectService and workspace identity owner
invariants: Project belongs to one environment
Canonical upstream repository identity separate from fork origin display identity
Task folder paths preserve multi-repository structure and linked shared folders
Project settings and scripts remain environment owned

user_outcomes: Browse/read/write workspace files; search contents and names; attach uploads and issue asset URLs
families.rust_owner: WorkspaceFileService, immutable search snapshots and AttachmentStore
invariants: Ignore/symlink/path/read-only rules
Uploads outside workspace require ownership claim
Attachment prompt path is not permission grant
Signed URLs check inode/device identity at open
Search stale-index and refresh behavior remains usable
cost_opportunities: Replace long shared picker lock with immutable query snapshots and bounded updates; current native fff async implementation already avoids JS blocking

user_outcomes: Open/attach/observe/write/resize/clear/close persistent remote PTYs
families.rust_owner: PTY owner and bounded output/persistence pipeline
invariants: Environment owns PTY, all clients share lifetime
Replay never causes terminal response writes
UTF8-safe bounded tail restore
Drain output on close/restart/clear; independent observation vs input authorization
Process/session cleanup platform specific
cost_opportunities: Preserve incremental output and coalesced persistence; avoid reintroducing full scrollback copies

user_outcomes: Branches, refs, worktrees, pulls, stacked actions, commit/diff review and PR-thread preparation
families.rust_owner: GitRepositoryService with per-cwd operation coordination
invariants: Git hooks/config/auth/submodules/worktree and platform semantics
Per-cwd singleflight status refresh and branch coherence
HEAD parent-directory watch handles atomic rename
Local/remote status caches distinct
Do not claim a partial Rust Git library replaces all supported mutations
cost_opportunities: Share repository snapshots and coalesce invalidations without losing external filesystem changes

user_outcomes: Authenticate, discover/clone/publish/star repositories across supported hosts
families.rust_owner: SourceControlRegistry with provider-specific HTTP/auth clients
invariants: Registry includes GitHub, Cursor Origin, GitLab, GitCafe, TanStack Source, Forgejo, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps
Feature gates retained
Host credential scoping and rate limits
Read/mutation capabilities vary by host
families.review: registry_and_contract_inventory; host implementation branches not audited

user_outcomes: List/filter/route/read PRs; review guides; comments/reviews/reactions; checks, labels and reviewers
families.rust_owner: PullRequestService with typed host adapters and durable local review state
invariants: Remote mutations and local views distinct authorities
Review positions/file revisions and seen-state identities preserved
Routing trust revoked on route-set change, not reorder
Watch reactors settle only under no-newer-activity guards
External merge commands can trigger reconciliation
families.review: all contract methods enumerated; persistence reviewed in DB report; full remote host semantics not audited

user_outcomes: Connect trackers; list/read/create/comment/update/react; bind projects and link threads
families.rust_owner: IssueService plus standalone and host issue drivers
invariants: Linear standalone plus host-integrated issue APIs
Explicit credential scopes/bindings
Unknown implementation reported unsupported
Cross-environment routing does not change remote authority

user_outcomes: Expose T3 tools to embedded agents, outside OAuth clients and linked environments
families.rust_owner: McpServer plus centralized ToolAccess and credential context
invariants: Discovery visibility is not authorization
Thread credentials required for self/delegation/secret functions
Mode ceilings and link-origin fence enforced centrally
Target environment checked before sending; target object checked where it lives
Outside MCP token cannot use WS to bypass audience

user_outcomes: Run embedded MCP apps, read their resources, call tools and update model context
families.rust_owner: McpAppBroker plus model-context persistence and provider request owner
invariants: Provider session and caller authorization retained
Model context tied to originating app/tool and thread
Resource/tool call cancellation and capability boundaries
HTML rendering retains sandbox/host messaging behavior
families.review: contract and model-context persistence review; app transport handlers not fully audited

user_outcomes: Schedule autonomous runs; trigger signed hooks; inspect deliveries, run now and rotate tokens
families.rust_owner: Scheduler with durable due queue and conditional dispatch owner
invariants: Generation/token/enable checks at dispatch, no stale run after changes
Raw body bytes used for signature validation;1MiB cap
Relay proof required before trusting relay ID/time/trace
Dedup/coalescing/rate/queue controls survive restart
Accepted/running dispatch prompt identity preserved on recovery
Claim transfer and queue admission cannot be interrupted halfway
cost_opportunities: Deadline-indexed wakeups and batched due reads already partially represented; optimize only measured scheduler work

user_outcomes: Share a restricted thread view and accept guest message proposals
families.rust_owner: GuestShareService tied to thread state and HMAC credential
invariants: Share replacement/archive revokes access
Guest token is not a normal session and cannot call RPC/MCP
Guest messages are proposals with owner acceptance/dismissal
Share/attachment/history visibility follows thread-only rules

user_outcomes: Link environments; delegate remote work; view and interrupt remote threads
families.rust_owner: PeerLinkRegistry, token store, forwarding service and follower actors
invariants: Environment identity independent of endpoint; descriptor alone is not cryptographic proof
Only user-trusted addresses get credentials
Caller namespace hashed into idempotency keys
Mode limit only narrows; limited link origin fences mutations/derived work
Remote expiry owned by receiver
Waits chunked at50s; stream relay lifetime follows local subscription
Feature-off permits existing task reads/waits/stops on linking side

user_outcomes: Open/control browser previews, inspect pages, operate browser automation, manage profiles and local servers
families.rust_owner: PreviewSupervisor and browser context owner with authenticated stream/tunnel
invariants: Loopback tunnels stay on owning environment
Profile/permission/user interaction ownership
Preview frame/file-origin sandbox and host messages
Automation session control and screenshots distinct from DOM page data
Stream and upload authentication retained
families.review: selected transport and contract review; full browser operation semantics not audited

user_outcomes: Use local/SSH/mobile simulators, EAS or Simlock devices, view streams and perform actions
families.rust_owner: DeviceSupervisor with host/session ledger and typed automation gateway
invariants: Host ID part of device identity
Installed hub and automation consent separate
Only owned EAS sessions stopped; billable limits/idle cleanup persisted
Simlock session/lease/cwd/TTL preserved
No unsafe arbitrary hub exec route
Video transports and no-transform behavior preserved
families.review: full internal architecture doc plus selected gateway/contract review

user_outcomes: Dictate into drafts using local or cloud transcription and manage models/voice streams
families.rust_owner: SpeechService with isolated worker lifetime and model store
invariants: Transcription edits draft, never sends turn itself
Cancel waits for native resource release
Explicit environment/provider/model/audio grant; no silent audio fallback
Catalog hash verification and foreign-cache ownership
Optional VAD degradation distinct from provider fallback
families.review: full internal architecture doc and HTTP contracts; native backend source not audited

user_outcomes: View usage, resource/process telemetry, diagnostics, traces and provider feedback
families.rust_owner: TelemetryCollector with bounded ring/history and source-specific usage readers
invariants: Sensitive bodies filtered before logging
Provider usage readers may open external provider-owned SQLite stores
Process signaling permissions and identity must be preserved
Telemetry stays off critical acknowledgement path
families.review: registry/logging selected review; individual telemetry collectors not fully audited
cost_opportunities: Retain delta filtering and bounded log traversal; profile allocation and encoding before redesign

user_outcomes: Manage settings/keybindings/providers; update services; diagnose/clean storage and reclaim DB space
families.rust_owner: ConfigurationService, InstallerSupervisor and MaintenanceCoordinator
invariants: Atomic settings publication and server/client scope separation
Updates only touch provably owned install
Maintenance cannot delete live provider/worktree/attachment ownership
Production owner and migration version fenced
Full backup/import/recovery semantics retained
families.review: contracts and prior persistence/maintenance review; all installer implementations not audited

user_outcomes: Discover and import native provider sessions, including ACP registry histories
families.rust_owner: AgentSessionImporter and provider-native history readers
invariants: Imported history is not fabricated native runnable state
Provider-specific path/ID/ownership
Legacy lazy imports preserved across migration
Deleting provider-native history requires exact owner/capability
families.review: contracts, provider constraints and prior external DB reader inventory; scanner branches not audited

limits: Family assignments are research categorization, not authorization mapping. RpcAuthorization remains normative.
All method declarations enumerated; full request/response schemas and every handler branch are not semantically audited.
Side-channel HTTP and embedded-provider protocols require separate contract preservation.
Rust owners are proposed architecture, not observed upstream modules.
